name: AirportOption
description: The option row rendered in Combobox's renderOption slot for airports: bold IATA code, airport name, then city and country.

provenance.tag: A · unverified ("airport name, city, country, and bold IATA code")

rules:
Layout:
[DXB]  Dubai International
       Dubai, United Arab Emirates
IATA: body-md 700. Name: body-md. City and country: body-sm in --color-text-subtle.
Combobox getOptionLabel must return the plain-text equivalent ("Dubai International, DXB, Dubai, United Arab Emirates").
rtl: The IATA code is wrapped in <bdi dir="ltr">.
